assets.instruction: Preserve fork geometry and alpha; add pale rope wear groove and two short frayed ends of old rope at the saddle.

Wrap a thick braided rope three times around the bare lower trunk above the fence; add a front-right knot, hanging frayed tail and left rope lead, preserving the full original tree and transparent framing.
Remove the rope only and restore bark/fence; retain tree, framing and transparent background for the untied state.

camera: Original fixed framing restored. No per-room follow mode.
